_meta.notes: BUNDLE: 5-page packet = the older (pre-2006) 'Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' whose title carries no year (interim options are April 5 / Seven days before a primary / September 15 / Seven days before a general), with the separate one-page 'Dissolution of a Candidate Campaign' notice as page 5 (committee 'Lee Gardner Campaign', secretary Pete Lund, committee established March 1994, signed 3-21-05). The FINAL REPORT box is checked AND the amendment 'Yes' box is checked with date of report 1-29-05. All Summary Page cells are slashed zeros; Column B is headed 'Year-to-Date Total' on this older form. A handwritten note under the table reads: 'The <$413.85> reflected on Report dated Dec. 3, 2002 represents a loan from Lee Gardner to the Lee Gardner Campaign.'

contributions.detail: exact - Schedule A (p3) has no line items; the filer wrote the word 'None' in the first Name of Contributor cell and left SUBTOTAL and TOTAL blank. Zero rows against the Summary Page's slashed-zero.

expenditures.detail: exact - Schedule B (p4) likewise carries only the word 'None' in the first Name of Recipient cell, SUBTOTAL and TOTAL blank. Zero rows against the Summary Page's slashed-zero.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: Neither schedule prints a subtotal or a total (both cells empty), so no page-subtotal gate exists here; the schedules are voided with the word 'None' instead. That is the one gate that could not fire and the reason is an empty schedule.
itemized.notes: FINAL / dissolution filing for Lee Gardner (Assessor), signed 3-21-05 and stamped RECEIVED MAR 21 2005; p5 is the separate 'Dissolution of a Candidate Campaign' notice (committee established March 1994, secretary Pete Lund). BOTH schedules are empty and voided with the handwritten word 'None'; every Summary Page cell carries a slashed zero. This is a real zero-activity closing report, not a gap. The Summary Page also carries a handwritten explanatory note - 'The ($413.85) reflected on Report dated Dec. 3, 2002 represents a loan from Lee Gardner to the Lee Gardner Campaign' - which refers to a PRIOR report and is NOT a line item of this filing, so it is not transcribed as a row.
